todoistBoard.name: Full 1231 11th Avenue Remodel
todoistBoard.writeHoldNote: Todoist write hold in force (Tisa, 2026-11-08) until new specs & planning merges are locked; reading cards is active.
todoistBoard.synchronicityRule: Any Todoist record change must have corresponding synchronicity in its governing wiki doc (<room>/CHECKLIST.md, <room>/SPEC.md, STATUS-NOW.md, or decisions) in the same pass (Tisa, 2026-11-11).
knownStaleCardNotes: Bathroom toilet-wall furring card 6hvhMvhmWqgR52v7 is marked complete in Todoist while checklist requires reconciliation before repeating work.
Several electrical cards still describe an older C-10/permit path; locked rule (2026-11-05) is own crew wires Unit 4, no permit requested.
Some older kitchen sink-base subtasks show 51-81 / CL 66; governing kitchen/SPEC.md is 75-105 / CL 90 (card 6hvjQGPw7cf594p7 corrected).

en: Finish bathroom: blocking + full bathroom electrical rough-in (wires to attic junction box) -> close ceiling -> drywall & Hardie board -> wall tile -> set tub and sink.
Frame the electrical panel wall (D04 dining-side wall).
Finish the laundry closet: complete remaining rough-in, finish walls, and paint.
es: Terminar el baño: refuerzos + instalación eléctrica en bruto del baño (cables a caja en el ático) -> cerrar techo -> tablaroca y Hardie board -> azulejo de muros -> tina y lavabo.
Enmarcar el muro del panel eléctrico (muro D04 hacia el comedor).
Terminar el clóset de lavandería: completar pendientes de instalaciones, muros y pintura.

rooms.title: Laundry Closet
rooms.note: This week: finish the remaining rough-in, walls and paint. Resolve the gas box before covering the shared bathroom wall. Murphy door work belongs here.
rooms.noteEs: Esta semana: terminar los pendientes de instalaciones, muros y pintura. Resolver la caja de gas antes de cubrir el muro compartido con el baño. La puerta librero pertenece a esta lista.

rooms.title: Bathroom
rooms.note: John owns the bathroom. The crew chooses Ervin and Joel, or John with one helper while the third person handles other work. Slab installation remains conditional on support, tools, waterproofing and field readiness; the reported leak test is not close-in approval.
rooms.noteEs: John está a cargo del baño. La cuadrilla elige entre Ervin y Joel, o John con un ayudante mientras la tercera persona hace otro trabajo. La instalación de losas sigue condicionada a soporte, herramientas, impermeabilización y preparación en obra; la prueba de fugas reportada no autoriza cerrar.
